reasons.Lexical navigation candidate; catalogue: The theorem shown was selected from shared wording with OpenAI’s description. Atlas records no review confirming that it is the theorem the description means.
reasons.No unique candidate with at least three: No single paper statement clearly matches OpenAI’s description by wording, and no review identifying the intended theorem is recorded.
reasons.Read the solution-supplied definitions a: OpenAI’s proof file supplies some definitions. Atlas records no comparison confirming that they mean the same objects as the paper’s definitions.
reasons.No Lean object is recorded for this fami: The release has no Lean statement for this family.
reasons.The attributed exact check is undecided: An independent calculation did not decide the claim, or needs data absent from its source.
reasons.Recorded candidate or producer-declared: Atlas records no review of whether each linked Lean statement and paper theorem mean the same thing.
reasons.No imported accepted Comparator report b: Atlas records no independent report that Comparator accepted the proof at the release version shown here.
reasons.An AI scope draft has no named human rev: An AI agent drafted an assessment of which part of the paper this Lean statement expresses. No named human review is recorded.
